CustomField.description: Publicly accessible in the sense of § 2 Nr. 2 LSV (new numbering since 1 January 2026, taken verbatim from AFIR). This single flag switches four regimes on - LSV notification, Eichrecht, AFIR and THG eligibility - and switches § 14a EnWG OFF, because the statute covers only nicht oeffentlich-zugaengliche Ladepunkte. Never edit it without setting Oeffentlich_seit__c.
CustomField.label: Öffentlich zugänglich
